title: 消息称Anthropic贡献SpaceX超三分之一营收，合同潜在总额超 1200 亿美元
content:
October 30 news: Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that AI unicorn Anthropic has officially surpassed the U.S. federal government to become the largest single customer of Elon Musk's SpaceX.
According to SpaceX's latest filing submitted last week, in the just-ended third quarter, about 34.5% of the company's revenue came from a single customer, and this mysterious buyer mainly purchased related services from SpaceX's artificial intelligence unit responsible for providing computing power. People familiar with the matter confirmed to the media that the buyer referred to as "Customer B" in the filing is Anthropic.
In terms of the specific cooperation, Anthropic mainly leases massive computing resources from SpaceX's data center in Memphis, Tennessee. According to Anthropic's previously released IPO prospectus, the long-term contract signed by the two parties will remain in effect until 2029, with a potential spending cap of up to $120.5 billion.
At the current pace of performance, starting in December this year, Anthropic's monthly payments to SpaceX will soar to about $3.1 billion. However, the contract terms also preserve a certain degree of flexibility for both parties: Anthropic has the right to unilaterally cancel the contract after early 2027 by giving 90 days' written notice. This deep cooperation not only reflects the almost bottomless massive demand of current frontier AI companies for underlying computing power, but also unexpectedly makes SpaceX one of the most profitable behind-the-scenes winners in this round of the AI gold rush.

report.summary: 传Anthropic成为SpaceX最大客户，合同潜在总额超1200亿美元
report.background: 随着前沿大模型参数与推理需求暴涨，算力已成为AI公司最稀缺的战略资源。Anthropic此前主要通过AWS、Google Cloud获取算力，但随着Claude系列模型训练与推理规模扩大，开始寻求更多元的长期供给。SpaceX近年大举建设数据中心（含孟菲斯园区）并对外出租算力，从航天公司延伸为AI基础设施“卖铲人”。彭博援引知情人士称，Anthropic已超过美国联邦政府，成为SpaceX最大的单一客户，这一消息也让外界重新审视AI热潮中基础设施方的获利能力。
key_points: SpaceX最新财报披露，第三季度约34.5%的营收来自单一客户；知情人士确认，该神秘“客户B”正是Anthropic，其采购规模已超过美国政府。
合作核心是算力租赁：Anthropic主要租用SpaceX位于田纳西州孟菲斯的数据中心资源，双方签订的长约将持续到2029年。
合同潜在支出上限高达1205亿美元；按其披露的招股书口径，从今年12月起Anthropic每月向SpaceX支付约31亿美元。
合同保留了灵活退出机制：2027年初之后，Anthropic可提前90天书面通知单方面解约，说明双方都对长期需求存在不确定性。
这条消息的意味深长之处在于：AI淘金热中最赚钱的未必是模型公司，而是手握机房、电力和GPU的算力供应方。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，千亿美元级长约意味着算力竞争已从“抢卡”升级为“抢十年供给”，议价权正从模型公司向算力持有方转移，头部与中小玩家的差距会被进一步拉大。对开发者而言，上游成本刚性上涨，短期内API与推理价格难有明显下降，同时供应商绑定与迁移风险需要纳入架构设计。对普通用户而言，前沿模型的迭代速度与服务质量将越来越取决于上游算力供给，免费额度、响应速度和价格波动都可能受此传导。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注：Anthropic API与Claude系列模型、AWS Bedrock与Google Vertex AI（托管Claude）、开源推理框架vLLM与SGLang（用于自建推理优化），以及CoreWeave、Lambda等GPU算力租赁平台，便于对比自建与租用成本。
